title: The Part of a Resident Funds Transfer Applied to a Medicare Coinsurance Charge
content:
A return of overpaid coinsurance to a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account never exceeds **the transfer's paid part**: the part of the transfer that the coverage office applied to the coinsurance charge on the resident's episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage. The paid part follows how the transfer reached the charge:

| What the records show | Transfer's paid part |
|---|---|
| the Medicare ledger carries an ACH payment naming the charge on the transfer's date (of two that day, the one recorded first) | that payment, never more than the transfer, because the coverage office applies a payment only up to the charge's open balance and returns any remainder to the payer |
| it carries none, and a per-bill authorization names the charge | the amount the most recent such authorization states |
| otherwise | the whole transfer |

## Hypothetical illustration

A transfer of $1302.00 named a coinsurance charge.

| Records | Paid part |
|---|---|
| Medicare ledger: ACH payment of $1170.45 naming the charge on the transfer's date | $1170.45 |
| Medicare ledger: ACH payment of $1302.00 on the transfer's date | $1302.00 |
| no such payment; the most recent per-bill authorization naming the charge states $1250.00 | $1250.00 |
| no such payment and no authorization naming the charge | $1302.00 |
